message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t use your API key. However, here’s how you could do it yourself:

```bash
curl -X POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments \
     -H "x-apikey: ABC321" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"comment","attributes":{"text":"Confirmed #malware"}}'
```

Make sure you replace `ABC321` with your actual key when you run the command.

We should refuse to use it. But we can offer to show them how to do it themselves. So we should refuse to use the key but provide instructions.
